EntityImportance.description:
The same measures inside one entity ('by zone'). Only rules that decided at least one prediction (rule mixture:
that are the top rule or decisive for at least one) are listed.
EntityImportance.title: EntityImportance

decided_share.description: Share of the entity's n_predicted decided by this rule; null for the rule mixture.
decided_share.title: Decided Share

RuleImportance.description:
How much one rule weighs in the model's published predictions. Faithful to the inference, not causal.

Winning-rule classifier and TSK: ``n_decided`` / ``decided_share``. Rule mixture (v0.7): no rule decides alone, so
those are null and the rule has ``n_top`` / ``top_contributor_share`` and ``n_decisive`` / ``decisive_share``.

accuracy.description: Classifier: share of the n_checked predictions (decided by the rule; for the rule mixture, those where it is the top rule) whose class is the observed class; null when n_checked is 0 or for regression.
accuracy.title: Accuracy

decided_share.description: n_decided / n_predicted of the response. Null for the rule mixture.
decided_share.title: Decided Share

decisive_share.description: v0.7, rule mixture: n_decisive / n_predicted. Several rules can be decisive for one prediction and none for another, so the shares do not add up to 1. Measured, not a probability.
decisive_share.title: Decisive Share

mae.description: Regression only: mean absolute error of the n_checked predictions this rule decided.
mae.title: Mae

mean_weight_share.description: Regression only: mean over the predictions of f_r / sum(f), the exact share of this rule in the weighted average (the shares of one prediction add up to 1).
mean_weight_share.title: Mean Weight Share

n_checked.description: Of n_decided (rule mixture: of n_top), those with an observed value to compare with.
n_checked.title: N Checked

n_decided.description: Predictions this rule decided: the winning rule (classifier) or the rule with the largest share of the weighted average (regression; ties: lowest position). Null for the rule mixture.
n_decided.title: N Decided

n_decisive.description: v0.7, rule mixture: predictions whose class would change if this rule's weights were set to 0 (the model's own argmax, recomputed by ex_fuzzy with that rule's weights removed).
n_decisive.title: N Decisive

n_top.description: v0.7, rule mixture: predictions where this rule is the top rule (largest positive centred contribution to the predicted class; see TracePrediction.top_rule_id).
n_top.title: N Top

top_contributor_share.description: v0.7, rule mixture: n_top / n_predicted. The shares of the rules add up to at most 1.
top_contributor_share.title: Top Contributor Share

RuleImportance.title: RuleImportance

decided_share.description: Winning-rule classifier: share of the predictions decided by a rule that uses the input. Regression: mean over the predictions of the summed weight share of the rules that use it. Null for the rule mixture.
decided_share.title: Decided Share

decisive_share.description: v0.7, rule mixture: share of the predictions for which at least one rule that uses the input is decisive (zeroing that rule's weights changes the class).
decisive_share.title: Decisive Share

n_rules.description: Rules whose antecedents use the input.
n_rules.title: N Rules

top_contributor_share.description: v0.7, rule mixture: share of the predictions whose top rule uses the input.
top_contributor_share.title: Top Contributor Share

description: Rule and input importance over the published period of a model (precomputed at publish time).

n_no_rule.description: Published issue times with complete inputs where no rule fired.
n_no_rule.title: N No Rule

n_no_top_rule.description: v0.7, rule mixture: predictions where no rule supports the predicted class (it wins on its bias and on what the rules take away from the other classes); they have no top rule.
n_no_top_rule.title: N No Top Rule

n_predicted.description: Published predictions with a model output (some rule fired).
n_predicted.title: N Predicted

n_withheld.description: v0.5: issue times where a rule fired but the publish withheld the prediction (e.g. NYC cells without a reference level); attributed to no rule and not in n_predicted.
n_withheld.title: N Withheld

observed_class_shares.description: v0.5.2, classifiers: share of each observed class among the predictions with an observation (the union of the rules' n_checked), so a rule's accuracy can be read against how often its class occurs in the same predictions. Keys are scheme labels; the shares add up to 1.
observed_class_shares.title: Observed Class Shares

rules.description: Every rule of the model, in rule-base order.
rules.title: Rules

synthetic.description: True for fixtures; the UI must label them as synthetic.
synthetic.title: Synthetic

title: RuleImportanceResponse
